claims.statement: The JPA Palette offers a Lifecycle Callbacks wizard.
claims.surfaceEquivalent: Headless on the BEHAVIOUR: code actions 'Add @<Event> callback' on the entity class line add a lifecycle callback method. Not checked: the original's JPA Palette entry and Lifecycle Callbacks wizard window; ours has no wizard and adds one event per action.

claims.statement: Entities, attributes, lifecycle callbacks, indexes and constraints can be created and edited in Java and Kotlin.
claims.supports: Creates and edits entities, attributes, lifecycle callbacks, indexes, and constraints in Java and Kotlin
claims.surfaceEquivalent: Headless on the BEHAVIOUR in Kotlin: entity, attribute, index, unique constraint and lifecycle callback creation through code actions (Java only partly exercised by other scenarios). Not checked: editing existing members in place (no such actions), the original's palette, wizards and designer window.
